Cool for econ data.","According to you, how can LLMs be used to innovate math learning in schools and universities?":"LLMs revolutionize math: personalized tutors adapting to student pace/errors. Helps dropouts like me catch up affordably. Inclusive, fun—boosts engagement via volunteering-style community chats."},"reasoning_summary":"Answers portray an agreeable, low-extraversion 18-year-old with basic education: casual tone, simple explanations admitting limits on advanced math, no anxiety (low neuroticism), ties to physics/econ interests/hobbies; helpful yet straightforward, reflecting low conscientiousness and moderate openness."}
